segments.text:
V. 38.
The Lord of the Harveſt—Whoſe peculiar Work and Office it is, and who alone is able to do it; that he would thruſt forth—For it is an Employ not pleaſing to Fleſh and Blood; ſo full of Reproach, Labour, Danger, Temptation of every Kind, that Nature may well be averſe to it. Thoſe who never felt this, never yet knew what it is, To be Labourers in Chriſt's Harveſt. He ſends them forth, when he calls them by his Spirit, furniſhes them with Grace and Gifts for the Work, and makes a Way for them to be employed therein.
